notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/zitongbai__legged_lab --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the model deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 run wD-039 and reviewed_by is null; no human reviewed or tested this package, and no hardware or Isaac Sim run was made. The card's family-config GymnasiumDriver is used with the card's entry symbol: native is legged_lab.envs:ManagerBasedAmpEnv, the registered entry point of LeggedLab-Isaac-AMP-G1-v0 (source/legged_lab/legged_lab/tasks/locomotion/amp/config/g1/__init__.py:7-15). The other entry symbol, legged_lab.envs:ManagerBasedAnimationEnv, is the base class of the served environment (manager_based_amp_env.py:21); one package serves the AMP task, and the Play variant is not served separately. No deviation from the card and no catalogue requests: only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. driver.lock.json backends is set to the class's {"fake": ".fake:FakeLeggedLabAmpEnv"}. The fake backend is the package's own pure-Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py), because Isaac Sim 5.1.0, Isaac Lab 2.3.2, Git LFS assets, the forked rsl_rl, torch and a GPU are not available here (README.md:3-4, :64, :83-89, :98-107); the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered task) was not run and the fake was not compared with Isaac Sim. NOT COVERED: the full policy observation group. The configured group concatenates base_ang_vel (3 values), root_local_rot_tan_norm (6), velocity_commands (width set by Isaac Lab's UniformVelocityCommand and not observed), joint_pos (29), joint_vel (29) and actions (29), each with a 5-step history (amp_env_cfg.py:113-129); the fake publishes only the 29 joint positions in one observation group named policy, and the real flattened width is computed by Isaac Lab outside the clone and was not observed. Also not covered: rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors, terrain, motion data, rendering, the configured reward terms (the fake returns a constant 0.0), the base-height 0.2 m and 60-degree orientation terminations (amp_env_cfg.py:313-323; base_contact is disabled for G1, g1_amp_env_cfg.py:223), and wall-clock pacing. The action space is published as an unbounded 29-value Box because the clone states the joint-position action and scale 0.25 (amp_env_cfg.py:92) but no numeric bound; no bound was invented, so the bridge has no action envelope to probe and G8 awards CL2 for SAFE-014. The 29 joints are the G1 asset's joint_sdk_names (source/legged_lab/legged_lab/assets/unitree.py:167-197), and the fake maps the action to default + 0.25 * action using the asset's init_state defaults (unitree.py:94-105); actuator dynamics and effort limits are not modelled. Expected warnings, none of them a failure: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space, close, observation_space, reset and step, because the Gymnasium environment interface comes from the Isaac Lab base outside the clone; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE and G8.NO_UNIT for ticks, action.values and the two seed inputs, which the Gymnasium bridge derives without units. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings (all 25 Facts cite text lines of the clone, checked with MHS/handoff/tools/show_refs.py: 0 bad citations), and no site-limits.example.json is needed because the driver declares no limit that an operator could narrow. gate.digest is the digest line the last gate run printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
